reason: The metadata-only capacity census showed thousands of species can satisfy the 100-photo condition. Measuring every full-target species would turn the bounded repeated-world-map design into an all-at-once CPU mega-analysis. This amendment fixes the pixel-measurement envelope before candidate acquisition or any global flower-colour pixels are opened.

measurement_species_budget.selection_rule: If full_target_species is at most 500, measure every full-target species. Otherwise rank all full-target inat_taxon_id values by SHA256(seed + unit-separator + inat_taxon_id), with taxon ID as deterministic tie-break, and measure the first 500 taxa.

computational_interpretation: At the maximum 100-photo capacity target, the pixel workload is capped at 50,000 photographs. The 200 outer realizations then repeatedly draw 250 species and 20 photos per species from this measured frame; repetitions estimate map stability and do not multiply biological sample size.
